basic_info.description: Here is your opportunity to own a fabulous two-unit flat in the prestigious Laurel Heights neighborhood. It is quite rare to find a four-bedroom, two-bathroom upper flat that offers views of the city, along with a three-bedroom, two-bathroom lower flat. This property presents the ideal opportunity to live in one unit while generating rental income from the other, helping to subsidize your mortgage. The building features a full garage that provides an abundance of storage space, with potential for expansion. The building has separate PG&E meters, a shared laundry station and backyard. Situated just minutes away from Laurel Village Shops, Laurel Hill Playgrounds, restaurants & cafs, Trader Joe's, Target, the Presidio, the University of San Francisco, California Pacific Medical Center, Kaiser Permanente, and numerous of other amenities. Easy access to public transportation and other parts of the City.
